why_it_matters.text: A cancer medicine known as 5-FU, used for bowel and other cancers and as a cream for skin lesions. It is uracil with one fluorine atom swapped in.

approval.basis: Marketed today (prescription) under NDA 016831 in the Drugs@FDA data files.
